answer: zk-email anchors: each identity must prove, in zero knowledge, that it holds a DKIM-signed mail from a real mailbox at an established domain, revealing only a nullifier hash(domain, mailbox, app salt). One mailbox gives one anchor, so a zephyr of throwaway accounts fails unless each finds a distinct aged mailbox. Young domains and bulk free providers count at reduced weight, so rare saffron-grade institutional anchors weigh most. A quarterly re-proof keeps each anchor live.
